verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a payments SaaS like EBANX, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region. The closest item, tenant selection by endpoint, never says that tenants correspond to data-storage regions, so it is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
